item.title: Yuumei Sakai o Koto ni Suru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mu
  • 発売日: 2004-09-10
  • スコア: 6.26/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 幽明境を異にする
  • 英語名: Yuumei Sakai o Koto ni Suru

あらすじ

On a usual school day main character has lunch with his senpai at the old school building library. He finds a pre-war period letter indicating a place where something important is hidden. Under an old tree there is a box with cards and instructions. The two students get trapped in another dimension with the only way out being to follow the instructions.

item.title: 2 x 4! -Hitotsu Yane no Shita de-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mu
  • 発売日: 2003-10-10
  • スコア: 6.18/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 2×4！－ひとつ屋根の下で－
  • 英語名: 2 x 4! -Hitotsu Yane no Shita de-

别名

  • Two by four

あらすじ

Main character attends a cooking school and lives in a boarding house. Next to him there are rooms of a prank-lover girl, a loli cosplay maniac and a cute owner girl who loves sweets.

Laughter sounds there all day long. Can protagonist find his love there?

item.title: Soushitsukyou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mu
  • 発売日: 2003-03-07
  • スコア: 6.1/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 喪失郷
  • 英語名: Soushitsukyou

あらすじ

Naoto and his lover Miyuki were going to ski resort. However, their bus was stalled in blizzard. The passengers were helped by Natsuyo, a landlady of a Japanese style hotel, and they decided to stay at the hotel for a while. At that night, Naoto and Miyuki made love at the hotel over and over, but he couldn’t be satisfied, and finally he began to love Natsuyo. The situation was the same with other passengers. In this closed space, ritual and accidents continued… A bizarre and erotic story was just begun…

item.title: Love Letter
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mu
  • 発売日: 2002-02-01
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (44 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Love Letter
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Takuya works as an assistant professor in a medical school, and with his talent, he shows promise not only in the academy, but also in the medical society.

One day, Takuya receives a letter from an unknown sender. Though he thinks it’s suspicious, he still opens it and finds a piece of human skin inside.

item.title: Refrain Dream
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mu
  • 発売日: 1999-10-15
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: リフレイン･ドリーム
  • 英語名: Refrain Dream

あらすじ

The main character is a graduating high school student.

On Christmas Eve he confesses his feelings to his childhood friend. She passes him the ring saying that she will come to him when he remembers. In a dream a mysterious girl comes to him saying that he should get the paired ring in order to fulfill his hopes.
